in-004.because: Every other answer was about the water and this one was about the traders — nobody loses a day's selling, and in ten years my grandchildren will be arguing in front of a painted wall about which flood was the big one.

in-011.because: I have been maintaining those stakes for four years like a man tending graves, and this is the only letter that told me to keep them and gave them a job — two years from now the whole promenade is magenta and nobody remembers the trees.
